use_case_summary: Primary workload: customer-facing personal-finance chat (conversational UI) + document search across user statements and help docs. Also considering a reranking pipeline for fraud signals where embeddings + reranker reduce false positives. Targets: p50 latency <250ms for short chat turns, p95 <600ms; throughput initial 10-20 qps with bursts up to 40 qps. Cost sensitivity: moderate (SMB budget) — wants batching/caching guidance. Model preferences: open-curated models for cost, Redwood-verified variants acceptable; needs routing to cheaper variants during low-sensitivity workloads. Security: SSO/SAML for dev/admin access, audit logs, possibility to integrate customer KMS in future.
